name: tanuh-small
notes: Phase 1 Day 4: a deliberately small dataset in organisation 3, to prove the generate/load/gate path before day-180 volumes. id_base clears the rows the bundle created. supervisor_level is Taluka because the hierarchy is now truncated at Village: Tanuh's organisation_config restricts Patient registration to Village via customRegistrationLocations, and the sync scope query intersects a user's catchment with exactly those types -- an empty intersection matches nothing. Generating down to Health Center, one level below, put every subject and every catchment outside the permitted set, and Individual was dropped from syncDetails while the 10,800 encounters still synced. With Village as the leaf, field-worker catchments land on villages and Taluka is the level above them.
